submitted.rationale: Of the 3 measured compositions, Mn0.49Sr0.51 (near SrMnO3 stoichiometry) gave the highest photocurrent, 4.26e-6 A. That is about two orders of magnitude above both the Mn-rich side and the Sr-rich side.

rejected.reason: Mn-rich (Mn0.85): 3e-8 A, likely MnOx/SrMn7O12, poor photoactivity
Sr-rich (Mn0.35): 1e-8 A, Sr7Mn4O15/Sr2MnO4 region, negligible photocurrent
